title: Disaster Lending: “Fair” Prices but “Unfair” Access
authors: Taylor A. Begley; Umit G. Gurun; Amiyatosh K. Purnanandam; Daniel Weagley
eligible_reason: No staggered binary treatment. Tables 5, 7 and 8 are county-disaster cross-sections of SBA home-loan denial (or default) on continuous standardized subprime share, minority share or Gini, with disaster and state x year FE. Tables 6-7 'DD' stack SBA denial rates with lagged FHA home-improvement denial rates in the same county-year (d_SBA = lender type, absorbed stcou_year FE) and interact d_SBA with continuous minority share. Tables 9-10 regress changes in subprime share or delinquency on continuous county characteristics.
design_notes: MS_DisasterLending_Main.do: Table 5 reghdfe deny_home z_SP_Shr|z_minority [$X] i.EV_YRmin, absorb(i.year#i.statecode), cluster(STCOU); Table 6 reghdfe denyDD_home d_SBA d_SBA_X_z_minority (or minority bins), absorb(stcou_year); Table 7 alternative continuous interactions; Table 8 default_home on z_minority/z_Gini, absorb(st_yr EV_YRmin); Table 9 changes in subprime share; Table 10 delinquency changes absorb(st_yrmo). model_figures.R: theory figures, Tables 1-2.
software_notes: Stata reghdfe; R for model figures.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not a staggered DiD.
